function.name: document_view
function.description: Converts a PDF or PPTX document to Markdown so you can read and analyze its contents. Text PDFs are extracted quickly; scanned PDFs are recognized with OCR and may take a while. Documents over 100 pages or 30 MB are rejected, and the markdown is cut to a bounded preview (a few thousand characters) to keep the context small; the result reports total_chars and output_truncated. Never paste the whole document into the chat: quote only the fragment needed for the answer. Use a URL for a document available online, or omit url when the teacher attached a PDF/PPTX file in the current message. Google Drive and Google Docs links are downloaded through the teacher's connected Google account; never open them manually. Do not invent URLs or file names.

url.description: HTTP(S) URL of the PDF or PPTX document. Use only a URL provided by the teacher or returned by another tool.

file_name.description: Exact name of the document. Use the attachment name when more than one supported file is attached, or the file's name for a Google Drive/Docs URL (e.g. 'Лекция 1.pptx') so the right converter is used.
